trigger: after a single-station 2018 zero and annual counts revealed positive counts in other years
boundary_test: compare provider counts ending on 12/31 versus 01/01 of next year; count equality or difference does not establish inclusion rules or daily quality
secondary_selection: next-longest non-buoy brook-labeled QA metadata span; selected post-hoc after examining roster metadata, not temperature observations or model errors
scope: public count endpoint only; empty other filters; no individual temperature values or predictions requested
interpretation: provider counts may include non-temperature parameters, duplicate or estimated records, and lack unique-date evidence; no reference qualification or group independence is inferred
